raw_text: This fake Indian Navy sinking video is a case study in military disinformation. The production quality is low but the amplification strategy is sophisticated: simultaneous posting across Telegram, X, and Urdu news sites within a 90-minute window suggests coordinated information operations. Maritime OSINT community debunked it rapidly using AIS vessel tracking data showing no anomalies.
